title: The Media Releases Suite Framework: Media Release Record
body:
This record is the framework for the whole suite: one flagship database plus eleven family pairs covering CD releases, track releases, vinyl records, tape releases, Billboard song releases, Billboard movie releases, historical TV airtimes, and upcoming TV airtimes, plus three artist discography pairs.
